title: Deepfakes and impersonation
meaning: Someone uses AI or editing to make fake images, videos or audio of you, or pretends to be you online.
examples_and_warning_signs: Edited or AI-made pictures or videos using your face
Fake accounts using your name or photos
Friends telling you about posts you never made
steps: Do not share or forward the content, even to prove it is fake.
Note the link, username and date instead of copying the images.
Report the post and account to the platform.
Report at cybercrime.gov.in with an adult's help.
seek_immediate_help: Fake sexual or intimate images of you exist
You are being blackmailed or threatened
school_support: School counsellor or cyber safety coordinator
disclaimer: Never send or share intimate images of anyone under 18, including yourself. Get help from a trusted adult instead.
